Strategy: Twice-minimum targeting. Prefer the bin whose residual is closest to twice the smallest feasible residual, with a slight tilt toward tighter fits. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin is much smaller than twice its own residual while another bin sits near that target. It may help by preserving the tightest slot for a future item that needs it, but may fail if no later item needs that tight slot.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mn = min(bins)
    return [-abs(r - 2 * mn) - 0.05 * (r - item) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Leave-one-out mean targeting: prefer bin closest to mean residual of the other bins.
